chunks: And will live for ever under it. How evil the burden they will carry on the Day of Doom!
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'burden' mentioned in Surah Taa-Haa regarding the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological and spiritual weight of sins, where 'burden' (himlan) signifies the cumulative effect of one's actions that becomes a crushing load on the Day of Resurrection. It serves as a profound reminder for believers to cultivate taqwa (God-consciousness) to avoid this eternal heaviness, linking directly to the concept of individual accountability emphasized in the Quran.
